course.title: Urban and Regional Economics
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose a city permits 100 housing per year and the equilibrium housing price is 10 million per unit in a (18) suburb. If the city authority decides to permit 60 buildings per year, what would be the effect on the housing price? Estimate the price of housing permit and demonstrate the implications of such policy.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
